prose: Three things separate paper ownership from real ownership for codemother over the inspectors and gates (build_inspector, harbor_master, tester, ruling, corrosion): 1. A hand. Her shim needs a crossing verb that fires the harbor door as actor codemother. Plumbing, one day. 2. The line up. inference_domain in the rack and staying up (measured 2026-09-06: no inference_domain process running, bus request to it hangs 20s+, hex.local answers directly in under 5s with qwen2.5:7b; her root tree holds 47 seeded nodes). Plumbing, and already overdue for other reasons. 3. A judgment. What she checks before admitting a crossing, beyond the door's existing standing-proof check: what the mom looks at, what makes her refuse, what she learns from a refusal that was wrong. That is a real design session between Akien and CC, not a build. Items 1 and 2 do not wait on it. Akien 2026-09-06: 'i am on board with all of those.'
